editorial:
Ever wondered what happens when a grumpy green monster decides he has had enough of holiday cheer? You get to meet the Grinch, a mean guy who lives on a mountain and hates everything the Who-folk love about Christmas. Along with his poor dog, Max, he comes up with a wild plan to dress up as Santa and swipe every single gift and decoration from the village. It is a short, sweet, and funny ride that perfectly captures that feeling of being a holiday grouch while still keeping things light and magical for the whole family.

What really makes this one a winner is the classic animation style and the great voice acting that makes the Grinch feel truly mischievous. The pacing is quick, so you will never feel bored, though it is very short compared to modern movies. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those crisp colors, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a perfect pick for kids or anyone who needs a reminder that the holidays are about more than just stuff. Adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is also a smart move for yearly traditions.
endingExplained: After the Grinch steals everything, he expects the Whos to cry. Instead, they gather and sing a happy song together. This shocks him and causes his heart to grow three sizes larger. He realizes that love and community are what matter most. He brings all the stolen gifts back to the village and is welcomed as a friend, eventually joining the Whos for a giant Christmas feast.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic holiday stories and cute animation.
